featured_reviews.review_text:
An Exceptional Leg Day training with Nomaan Mukri at Plus Fitness Gym

I had a leg day session with Nomaan at Plus Fitness, and I am absolutely impressed by the quality of the training. I can't recommend him enough to anyone serious about making real progress.
The session began with a comprehensive 30-minute warm-up. I'll be honest, I never realised how much of a difference a proper warm-up could make until today. Nomaan's approach made my muscles feel activated and ready, which completely changed the effectiveness of the entire workout.
When we got into the main leg exercises, Nomaan's expertise was immediately apparent. He guided me through multiple variations and masterfully showed how a small change in angle or form could target a completely different part of the muscle. It was a lesson in anatomy as much as it was a workout! He has a gift for pushing you beyond your comfort zone in the most encouraging way. With his guidance, I was able to safely increase both my repetitions and the weight, achieving more than I thought I was capable of.
Throughout the session, Nomaan shared invaluable knowledge about how to stabilise progress and ensure long-term gains. It's clear he is incredibly well-versed in how different bodies should be trained, considering factors like gender, age, and overall health to create a truly personalised experience.
We finished with a fantastic stretching session that left me feeling strong and mobile, not just exhausted. What truly sets Nomaan apart is his professionalism combined with a genuinely humble and supportive attitude. He makes you feel like a teammate on your fitness journey.
If you want a trainer who is not just a rep-counter but a true teacher and motivator, you must train with Nomaan. My perspective on training has completely changed for the better!

I have been a member of this gym for almost 3 years, and honestly, I am extremely disappointed with how they handled a serious medical situation.

To be clear, I never asked for a refund or cancellation. I only requested that my current membership period be paused due to a major surgery.

What disappointed me most was the lack of professionalism and transparency. Different things were communicated on different calls, promises of manager callbacks kept getting delayed, and every solution revolved around extracting more money instead of supporting a loyal customer during a genuine medical emergency.

The shocking part is that the gym does advertise account freezing options in their own marketing communications, yet during an actual medical situation they suddenly claim “there is no such policy.”

If this is how a loyal 3-year customer is treated after ACL surgery, new customers deserve to know what kind of support they can realistically expect once the membership payment is done.

I hope the owners take this feedback seriously and improve how they handle medical cases and customer support in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text: If you are looking for the best transformation gym, Body Sculptor is the place to be. The level of personal attention and scientific programming here is superior and result-oriented. The facility is totally clean and hygienic, which is a huge plus. The trainers really matter here—they don’t just show you exercises, they ensure your form is perfect and your nutrition is on track. Highly recommended for anyone seeking serious results!

featured_reviews.name: mitul bilimoria
featured_reviews.review_text:
Firstly, I want to sincerely thank Prashant Sir for giving us Body Sculptor. For me, this is not just a gym — it’s a shrine. Every single time I walk in, and by the time I walk out, I feel like a stronger, better version of myself.

Training under Mr. Noor Alam Khan has been transformational. He doesn’t just understand your goals — he makes them his own. Over the last two months, he has helped me break mental barriers I didn’t even realize were holding me back — the “I can’t lift this,” “this is too tough,” or “this isn’t possible” mindset. Today, that has shifted to “we can achieve anything we commit to.” That mindset shift itself is the real magic of Alam Sir and this gym.

Alam Sir demands commitment, consistency, and intensity — and in return, you see real progress. Every session has structure, purpose, and measurable improvement. You don’t just train here; you evolve.

If you are serious and, more importantly, committed to your fitness goals, this place will elevate you every single day you show up.

Thank you once again to Prashant Sir, Noor Alam Sir, all trainers, and the entire Body Sculptor team for helping me become a better version of myself each day.

Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: ANSH MISHRA
featured_reviews.review_text:
It has been 2 years for me to be at body sculptor and firstly I really want to appreciate Mr. Prasant Sawant sir for his supportive nature, I never have to think before communicating him, he is always ready to share his guidance and I am really touched by his caring behaviour.
I love going to the gym grateful for the space my trainer ( VISHWAL ) pushes me to my best and my dietitian ( DHWANIE ) is very sweet and always present for my query  and even housekeeping ( Pravin ) is very helpful. Overall thank you bodysculptor for being my accountability squad and hoping many years of gains and growth.

featured_reviews.name: Pallavi Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm thoroughly enjoying my fitness journey with Mr. Noor Alam Khan - his dedication, knowledge, and passion for fitness are truly inspiring! He's sincere in his approach, pushing me to give my best with varied exercises tailored to my needs.

The gym is exceptionally well-maintained, equipped with high-end machines, and the staff is courteous and professional. Prashant sir, the owner, personally ensures every client is looked after, making sure everything is provided and clients can focus on their fitness goals hassle-free. Highly recommend this gym and Mr. Noor to anyone looking for a great fitness experience!

featured_reviews.name: Hiten Tejwani
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been working out with Body Sculptor for more than 10 years now ofcourse not regularly, but the experience is mind blowing . Prashant Sawant has designed individual workouts keeping in mind the body type and lifestyle of all his members a that’s the reason each time is go there to workout there’s a drastic change in my body . The equipments are top class and the trainers are also very good . The best place to start your journey of a healthy body.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Naik
featured_reviews.review_text: Hi had a really bad spinal injury. Then I joined Bodysculptor and the support which I got was exceptional. In 3 month have have seen major change in my back injury. featured_reviews.name: Dhwanie Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text: I love my working out at Bodysculptor.  They have premium trainers, nutritionist, and other services. The trainers are exceptional. Prashant Sawant's workouts are really transforming. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Karthik B
featured_reviews.review_text: Love the space! There’s something for everyone, from personalized training to group sessions. This is a great place to begin your fitness journey and if you're already on one then to build on it & grow.

featured_reviews.name: Roshin Mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text: Have been watching on social media, all the good work done by the fitness coaches of Breathe Studio and I was glad to witness it in the Hyrox simulation conducted last weekend. The studio is just like they mention on the website, all positive vibes and well equipped for all fitness milestones 👌. Am looking forward to more fitness experiences with Breathe Studio.

featured_reviews.name: Rehan Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: The most aesthetic and equipped fitness studio I’ve visited . Coaches here are absolutely fantastic with their knowledge and the way they host both their group and personal sessions. Getting a membership here if you’re a fitness enthusiast is a non negotiable.

featured_reviews.name: Rachel Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: I took my mom for parent jam. And i couldn't have chosen a better place for my mom's first workout! She's 50 this year and never moved, but this one session was a game changer for her. She's been reaching out to more classes and started moving intentionally. And that was exactly the intention set by the trainers for the class. They were so patient, loving and sweet. It meant everything to me.

featured_reviews.name: Chelsea Mather
featured_reviews.review_text: Best gym I have been to in Mumbai! Loved the session - really kind staff, felt very welcomed. Trainers were great at helping me with my form and progressions. Modern setup, love the look and vibe of the place. Also a cafe within the gym to go to after. Can’t wait to go back for my next session!
